steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, under the "Source Volume" selection section, choose the volume for segmentation.

operations.description: Choose the source volume for segmentation in the Segment Editor module.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, create a new segmentation named "Cranial_Segmentation".

operations.description: Create a new segmentation named Cranial_Segmentation in the Segment Editor.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Add" button and rename the segment to "Cranial_Segment".

operations.description: Add a new segment to the segmentation and rename it to Cranial_Segment.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Threshold" button.

operations.description: Activate the Threshold effect in the Segment Editor.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, adjust the threshold range bar to set the range value for segmentation.

operations.description: Adjust the threshold range bar to set the segmentation range.

steps.description: In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Apply" button.

operations.description: Apply the threshold effect to the active segment.

steps.description: In the "Skull segmentation" section, choose the segment node.

operations.description: Select the skull segmentation node used by the extension.

steps.description: In the "Entry points" section, choose the Point List node.

operations.description: Select the entry points Point List node containing the fiducials.

steps.description: Click the "1. Compute symmetry plane" button.

operations.description: Run Step 1 to compute the symmetry plane and display the skull model.

steps.description: If further adjustments are required, tick the "Manually adjust the symmetry plane" checkbox. If not, jump to step 13.

operations.description: If further symmetry plane adjustments are required, enable manual adjustment; otherwise skip to step 13.

steps.description: Manually adjust the symmetry plane.

operations.description: Manually adjust the symmetry plane using its interactive handles.

interaction.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the symmetry plane using its interactive handles.

steps.description: Click the "Apply adjustment" button.

operations.description: Apply the manual symmetry plane adjustment.

steps.description: In the "Crop radius (mm)" section, adjust the range bar to set the range value for crop.

operations.description: Adjust the crop radius range in mm for the skull cylinder cut.

steps.description: Click the "2. Cut skull (cylinder)" button.

operations.description: Run Step 2 to cut the skull with a cylinder.

steps.description: If the mandible is still attached to the maxilla, tick the "The mandible is still attached to the maxilla" checkbox. If not, jump to step 20.

operations.description: If the mandible is still attached to the maxilla, run separation; otherwise skip to step 20.

steps.description: Click the "3. Seperate maxilla / mandible" button.

operations.description: Run Step 3 to separate the maxilla and mandible.

steps.description: If further adjustments are required, tick the "Manually adjust the segmentation plane" checkbox. If not, jump to step 20.

operations.description: If further separation plane adjustments are required, enable manual adjustment; otherwise skip to step 20.

steps.description: Manually adjust the separation plane.

operations.description: Manually adjust the maxilla/mandible separation plane using its interactive handles.

interaction.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the maxilla/mandible separation plane using its interactive handles.

steps.description: Click the "Apply separation" button.

operations.description: Apply the manual separation plane adjustment.

steps.description: Click the "4. Identify zygomatic bones" button.

operations.description: Run Step 4 to identify the zygomatic bones and boundary planes.

steps.description: If further adjustments are required, tick the "Manually adjust the boundary planes" checkbox. If not, jump to step 24.

operations.description: If further boundary plane adjustments are required, enable manual adjustment; otherwise skip to step 24.

steps.description: Manually adjust the boundary planes.

operations.description: Manually adjust the left and right boundary planes using their interactive handles.

interaction.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the left and right boundary planes using their interactive handles.

steps.description: Click the "Apply boundaries" button.

operations.description: Apply the manual boundary plane adjustment.

steps.description: Click the "5. Generate Implant paths" button.

operations.description: Run Step 5 to generate implant paths and the plan table.

steps.description: If further adjustments are required, tick the "Manually adjust the paths" checkbox. If not, stop here.

operations.description: If further implant path adjustments are required, enable manual adjustment; otherwise stop here.

steps.description: Manually adjust the paths.

operations.description: Manually adjust the implant path line endpoints using interactive handles.

interaction.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the implant path line endpoints using interactive handles.

steps.description: Click the "Apply paths" button.

operations.description: Apply the manual path adjustments and update the plan table.
